notes: Cai dat: tai file HPCONS-BIM-Setup-2.0.22.exe ben duoi, DONG Revit roi chay (can quyen Admin). - Tu dong dung TUONG / VACH, COT, CUA DI, CUA SO, SAN tu net CAD import hoac Detail Item tren mat bang: gan vai tro cho tung layer (tu goi y theo ten layer), bam PHAN TICH xem so luong roi DUNG VAO MODEL. - Tuong net doi -> tim + do day (loai tuong co san dung do day, thieu thi tu tao CAD-Tuong-<t>); tuong net don = net tim; tu noi qua o cua, keo dai toi tim tuong giao de Revit join goc. - Cot chu nhat (co xoay) / tron theo hinh khep kin; type theo kich thuoc (b/h, Width/Depth, d), thieu thi tu tao.
